title: card.created@1
description: Notification that a card was created. Ids and codes only: no free text (CW-20261023-0001). Unknown fields are allowed.

revision.description: Card revision this event describes; responses are compare-and-set on it.

card_type.description: Card type code (for example approval, form, notify). A code, not a title.

risk.description: Risk class code, computed server-side. Absent means the most restrictive class.

op_digest.description: Digest over the exact change set a card's effects may run, where the card has effects.

source_app.description: App that owns the card, derived from the verified credential subject, never self-asserted.
